summary: Add divide support to the calculator
description: Extend POST /api/v1/calculate to support the divide operation without regressing existing calculator behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A request with operation divide, left 84, and right 2 returns HTTP 200 with a result of 42.
A divide request with a zero right operand returns HTTP 422 with the error code division_by_zero.
Existing health, add, subtract, multiply, unsupported-operation, and malformed-request behavior remains passing.
